state.intended_appearance: Blue sealing wax has a glossy clearcoat sheen with broad soft reflections and rounded perimeter ridges. Gold-leaf relief and lettering have a satin, nonmirror finish with smooth diffuse highlight-to-shadow transitions. The central C/check relief has crisp edges and soft bevel highlights; green woven ribbon stays matte.

gloss_intent.instructions: Does the surface sheen visible in `candidate` match `intended_appearance`?

criteria.true: The visible surface sheen follows the stated treatment direction.
criteria.false: The visible surface sheen contradicts the stated treatment direction.
